Summary: A judge must not take a gift — a bribe — for the bribe blinds the wise and perverts the words of the righteous.
Application: Scripture gives the reason with the command: a bribe blinds even the wise. No judge is so clear-sighted that a gift leaves his judgment untouched, which is why the ban is absolute rather than limited to proven corruption.
Purpose: Scripture's stated reason: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous (Exodus 23:8).
